pageConfig.title: Repeat Incident Detection
pageConfig.subtitle: Identify historically similar incidents and leverage previous resolutions to accelerate remediation

aiRecommendation.title: High probability repeat incident detected
aiRecommendation.message: This incident closely matches INC-2024-1720 (94% similarity). The previous resolution — rollback to v2.4.0 and connection pool increase — resolved the issue in 2h 15m. Consider applying the same runbook before exploring alternative fixes.

currentIncident.title: Production API Gateway timeout errors
currentIncident.description: Elevated 502/504 errors on API Gateway affecting customer account endpoints. Error rate spiked to 18% within 30 minutes of deployment v2.4.1.
currentIncident.rootCause: Deployment v2.4.1 reduced connection pool maximum from 500 to 200, causing upstream exhaustion under peak load.
currentIncident.businessImpact: Customer account summary and transaction APIs degraded. Estimated 12,400 users affected.

similarIncidents.title: API gateway timeout after deployment
similarIncidents.rootCause: Connection pool exhaustion introduced by deployment v2.3.8 configuration regression
similarIncidents.previousResolution: Rollback to v2.4.0 and increased HikariCP maxPoolSize from 200 to 400

similarIncidents.title: Upstream timeout on account endpoints
similarIncidents.rootCause: Database connection pool saturation during peak traffic window
similarIncidents.previousResolution: Scaled connection pool to 400 and enabled read replica routing for analytics queries

similarIncidents.title: Core banking service connection pool exhaustion
similarIncidents.rootCause: HikariCP pool size misconfiguration after environment promotion
similarIncidents.previousResolution: Reverted pool configuration and terminated long-running queries exceeding 5 minutes

similarIncidents.title: Database connection pool exhaustion
similarIncidents.rootCause: Long-running analytics queries holding database connections

similarIncidents.title: 502 errors after canary deployment
similarIncidents.rootCause: Canary deployment promoted before health checks stabilized
similarIncidents.previousResolution: Rolled back canary deployment and extended health check stabilization window to 15 minutes

similarIncidents.title: Payment gateway upstream latency spike
similarIncidents.rootCause: Dependency on degraded core-banking-svc caused cascading latency
similarIncidents.previousResolution: Enabled circuit breaker and routed payments through secondary region

similarIncidents.title: Identity service token validation delays
similarIncidents.rootCause: Redis cache eviction causing repeated database lookups
similarIncidents.previousResolution: Increased Redis memory allocation and tuned cache TTL policies
